events.text: Better placement ghost: render the armed MESH prop as the REAL mesh, translucent (alpha 0.5), tracking the snap target — replaces relying on the faint projected wireframe (which stays for parts props + footprint guide). New host doors __compiled_world_set/clear_live_mesh_ghost + appendMeshPropNode alpha_override; LoaderIsoView pushes meshGhostRef on snap/arm change. Shipping Zig.

USER RULING (req_1843): the mesh-zoo dev-room idea is SUPERSEDED — instead, 'Claude's Closet' = one big room of ACTUAL props in the ACTUAL map (window shopping). Compiling the one map makes all those kinds resident → instantly placeable everywhere. No separate dev-gamefile bake ('compiling the one is far better than doing all of them, that shit was silly').

resolution: Replaced the loader iso pane's faint projected-wireframe placement ghost with the REAL mesh rendered translucent (alpha 0.5) at the snap target, for mesh props — leveraging the same resident-mesh reference as the instant-placement fix (req_1812). world_loader gains a per-node ghost ref (setLiveMeshGhost/clearLiveMeshGhost doors __compiled_world_set/clear_live_mesh_ghost, one 20-byte keyHash,x,y,z,yaw); applyLiveMeshProps draws it through the shared appendMeshPropNode path with a new alpha_override param (a<1 routes to the transparent pass; all prior call sites pass null). JS meshGhostRef packs the armed prop kind's resident-mesh key + snap transform, LoaderIsoView pushes on each snap/arm change and clears when disarmed or on a non-mesh kind. The wireframe stays as the footprint guide + the ghost for parts props (no mesh). Also quieted the temp [live-push] log to fire only on missing doors. Shipped clean (hmsc-int rebuilt), committed. Alpha is a one-constant tweak (LIVE_MESH_GHOST_ALPHA) if the user wants it stronger/weaker.
